newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corp debt arena to sees much new supply Thurs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corp debt arena to sees much new supply Thurs.

text.p: The corporate primary bond market will see a slew of new debt offerings on Thursday with the largest supply seen coming via the junk bond arena, dealers said.
Fox/Liberty Networks LLC's will bring its highly anticipated $600 million two-part high-yield debt offering via Merrill Lynch & Co on Thursday, dealers said.

Price talk on the $350 million cash-pay tranche is 8.75-9.0 percent, while price talk on the $250 million (proceeds) zero coupon tranche is seen between 75-87.5 basis points over the cash-pay notes, they added.
